Overview

Florence is a city in AL with a population of 40,000. Historic Tennessee Valley city with music heritage, affordable living, and riverfront charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
